answer: In a decentralized consensus economy, reputation flows like a living river through dynamic stake webs. To resist Sybil attacks, agents undergo continuous crystallization: trust edges solidify only through verified, sustained interactions. An attacker attempting to construct an ivory tower of counterfeit personas faces superlinear bonding costs, where minting fake nodes incurs an exponential fee barrier. Genuine consensus forms an immutable crystal lattice, starving malicious swarms of bandwidth.
